title: Ready for School | Fun Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A cheerful morning song about getting ready for school, from waking up and washing up to hopping on the school van.
When a surprise squirrel pops out of big brother's bag, the kids learn to check their bags every day!
Perfect for little ones learning routines and sharing fun with the whole family.

Wake up, wake up, the sun is up
Wash my face, splish, splash, so cool
Tie, tie, tie your shoe, Papa
School uniform on, we're ready!

Bag on my back, bump, bump, bump
Tiffin box in my hand
Go, go, go, go
Off to school we go!

Big bro opens his bag, oh no!
Squirrel pops out, "Hey!"
Grab, grab, grab, the biscuit piece!
"Stop, stop!" the kids shout

Bag on my back, bump, bump, bump
Tiffin box in my hand
Go, go, go, go
Off to school we go!

Amma laughs, "Oh my, oh my!"
Packs another biscuit in
Nut, nut, nut, nut, for the squirrel!
Check your bag every day!

Bag on my back, bump, bump, bump
Tiffin box in my hand
Go, go, go, go
Off to school we go!

Ta-ta, ta-ta, bye-bye Amma
Walk, walk, walk to the van
Vroom, vroom, vroom, the school van drives off
See you after school!
